svg.aria-label: bkit's CI pipeline, flowing left to right: plan the run (work out what to test); check and build (quick checks, unit tests, integration tests, web, iOS and Android builds, database migrations); set the stage (preview deploy, reset test data); test like a user (web, iOS and Android end-to-end tests, and a live-site check); tidy up. Every lane feeds one final check, the only one merging needs, which fails if any lane failed, was skipped or ran zero tests. /bkit-build starts CI by opening the pull request, /bkit-debug reads the logs of any lane that fails and fixes it, and /bkit-ship merges only when the final check is green. In cloud mode, the result starts ship or debug by itself.
